_readme: Example pinyin fixed by hand after reviewing output/example_pinyin_disagreements.csv. Key: the sentence (punctuation doesn't matter). pinyin: every syllable, CITATION tones (不 bu4, 一 yi1, no third-tone change -- the export adds sandhi), neutral tone 5, erhua 儿 as r5. Checked like an AI answer (one syllable per character, real readings); a fix that fails is reported and not used. Used by run_all_grammar.py --export; wins over any AI answer.
